artifact_observations.reasoning: The handwritten text exhibits classic AI artifacts: characters are malformed, letters merge into each other, and some words are nonsensical or illegible. While intended to look like handwriting, the structural integrity of the letters fails upon close inspection.

The metal rings appear slightly warped and inconsistent in thickness. The connection points where the rings attach to the binder spine are vague and lack precise mechanical detail, appearing somewhat 'melted' into the background.
The lines defining the storyboard panels on the right page waver and do not maintain perfect straightness or consistent perspective convergence, suggesting slight geometric instability.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a binder and not just a stack of papers.
To rigorously analyze the legibility and structural correctness of the simulated handwriting, which is a high-risk area for AI artifacts.
To verify the physical connectivity of the metal rings to the binder spine and ensure no floating or fused elements.
To assess the overall realism of the lighting, shadows, and paper texture.

focus_areas: Legibility and character structure of handwritten text
Mechanical plausibility of the ring binder mechanism
Geometric straightness of drawn lines on the paper
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact. In AI images, simulated handwriting often looks plausible at a glance but fails character-level scrutiny. Determine if the illegibility is due to artistic style (messy handwriting) or generative failure (morphing letters). Also, verify if the ring mechanism has a physically valid anchor point.
